description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [100% Critical], [Damage Cap +10000], [Awoken Lucian King] and [Royal Mode] to the user

description.name: Awoken Lucian King
description.text: Fire, Earth and Lightning abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Fire, Earth and Lightning abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Royal Mode
description.text: Cast speed x3.00, casts Point-Blank Warp-Strike when removed

description.name: Point-Blank Warp-Strike
description.text: One single attack (3.10/6.20/9.70) capped at 99999 if the user used 0/7/11 Fire, Earth or Lightning attacks during the status, 100% hit rate
